#APEC为什么这么重要#
#世界目光聚焦中国#
【What does APEC mean to you and me?】What does APEC have to do with your everyday life? More than you'd think — from lower tariffs to more resilient supply chains, the Pacific's biggest economic circle works for ordinary people.
As Shenzhen gears up to host this year's APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting, here's how regional cooperation is shaping the Asia-Pacific's future — and delivering for everyone.
Source: Xinhua
